Preserve30ft and8d6. Use exact cone body-volume/cover gates, not inferred breathing or wind physics. Necrotic immunity, disease immunity, Poisoned immunity and nonbreathing are different predicates. State the continuing component duration/concentration explicitly to reconcile the Instantaneous cast label.

No free rest/reset or common progression engine is inferred.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual classes supply different cures, extra saves and immunities; poison-only antidotes and cleaning food do not cure established disease.

A source offering an extra save needs a real save and an exact outcome in this disease. Ordinary HP recovery is separate unless the new profile expressly provides a cure. Existing topical care can fulfill a stated step only; no new Supply/kit cost or treatment entitlement is invented from a recipe name. No contact spread, new environmental outbreak or imported real-world disease model without separate explicit authorship.
